messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy to eu1: inference v2.22.0 -> v2.23.0 (rollout 10%) commit f00ba7. post-deploy canaries started.

lina: Heads-up: synth probe for /v1/embeddings shows short 5xx bursts ~+75s after rollout. p95 for canary up from 340ms -> 1.4s and error spike to 0.7%.

aj: Is it broad or per-host? can you dump per-host synth counts?

maya: Per-host looks focused on eu1-node-4 and eu1-node-11. Logs show envoy connection resets to local worker and increased CLOSE_WAIT. no pod restarts.

ops-jordan: Recommend pausing rollout and diverting eu1 to previous release while we triage. Runbook: routectl set-route --region eu1 --target release:v2.22.0 --weight 100 --reason "post-deploy synth 5xx spike"

release-zoe: Pausing rollout now. No further batches.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by release-zoe. Route change queued.

ops-jordan: Route applied: eu1 -> release:v2.22.0 (effective). Queued quarantine for eu1-node-4 and eu1-node-11.

maya: Re-ran synth after diversion, errors dropped to baseline immediately. Quarantine + node restart scheduled, capturing flamegraphs and netstat samples.

aj: Follow-ups: add host-level netstat sampling to canary checks for first 5m, and a per-host error threshold that triggers auto-quarantine. Filing INF-4401 to track RCA and mitigation.

release-zoe: Noted. Marking release as "paused - region reverted" and adding INF-4401 to release actions. We'll retest after fixes in a controlled window.
